posts.title: An agentic code review command that attacks its own findings
posts.description: TL;DR /wtf-code-review is a Claude Code slash command that reviews code from a fresh context, so the conversation that wrote the change is not the one judging it. A cold reviewer reads the diff and runs the tests. A --deep flag adds eight additional subagents in parallel, one per dimension. Every finding that claims something breaks then faces a refuter told to kill it, so only the survivors print
